messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Use at least 5 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.) Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Every divider line must be exactly: "*****". Your output must begin with: "Think of the bride's look as". None of these may appear in the response: ['funeral'].

What kind of fashion would Frankenstein's bride wear? Make your answer weird or interesting. Use a divider line between paragraphs (not just blank lines). Use this exact divider line between paragraphs: "=====". Do not finish until all required keywords/phrases are included: ['funeral']. Make your response start with "Imagine the Bride's look as". Use at most 4 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.)
